host.description: Network interface to bind pgagroal to

port.description: Port for pgagroal to listen on

unix_socket_dir.description: Directory for Unix domain socket files

max_connections.description: Maximum total number of connections pgagroal can open to PostgreSQL servers

min_connections.description: Minimum number of connections kept open per pool

idle_timeout.description: Idle server connection timeout in seconds

auth_query.default: SELECT usename, passwd FROM pg_shadow WHERE usename = $1
auth_query.description: SQL query used to retrieve user credentials when using 'md5' or 'scram-sha-256'

log_file.description: Path to log file when log_type is 'file'

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key file

ssl_ca.description: Path to CA certificate file for client verification

ssl_crl.description: Path to certificate revocation list (CRL) file

reserved_connections.description: Number of connections reserved for superusers

query_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a query to complete (0 = unlimited)

query_wait_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) a client query can wait for a backend connection

max_client_conn.description: Maximum number of client connections per pool

log_server_messages.description: Log server-side log messages forwarded to clients

servers.description: List of PostgreSQL servers to pool

host.description: Host or IP of the PostgreSQL server

authentication.description: Optional authentication method for this server (if different from global)

users.description: List of PostgreSQL users managed by pgagroal

name.description: Display name for the user entry (not used for auth)

sslmode.description: SSL mode for user connections: 'disable', 'allow', 'prefer', 'require', 'verify-ca', or 'verify-full'

pool_size.description: Maximum connections in the user-specific pool

pools.description: Connection pools mapping databases/users to server pools

username.description: Username to connect as (must exist in users section)

reserve_pool_size.description: Number of connections reserved for emergency use

pool_mode.description: Pool-specific mode: 'session', 'transaction', or 'statement' (falls back to global)

server.description: Optional server name to pin this pool to (must match server: section name)
